text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I did it! I didn't sully the title of model student! A superhuman force! MEGA BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No need to hold back! Go ahead and shower me with praise!
choice_data_list: A champion can go even faster!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Being able to run spectacularly is the foundation of being the class representative after all!
choice_data_list: Do your best in the next one, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay! Leave it to me! The legendary genius, Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's aim for victory together! BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wowza! But you think I got what it takes to be a champion?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Basically you're telling me how much you believe in my next victory, right? Right?!
choice_data_list: Well, it's more that there's still room for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! As a genius, it would be an embarrassment if I couldn't live up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Come wind or rain! Or even the fires of hell! I will Bakushin to victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though I meant something different, it appears to have had a positive effect on Sakura Bakushin O.
